worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.summary: Fire two homing dragon darts at once: with two foes on the field each dart chases one (Split), with one foe both drive into the same target and hit harder (Focus).
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.use.0: Cover two spread-out foes at once
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.use.1: Chase a target that keeps moving
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.use.2: Stack both darts on one target for a burst
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.descriptio: Each dart deals about %1$s power on impact, %2$s darts in all; the target's defence, type and crit are settled per dart.
The darts chase within %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick and leave the body %3$s blocks apart.
A %1$s s gap separates the darts; each turns up to %2$s degrees per tick.
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.option.on: Split: with two foes each dart chases one, each at x1, covering two targets.
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.option.off: Focus: both darts chase the chosen target at x1.2 each, stacking the damage on one foe.
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.timing: Range %1$s blocks; windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.growth.0: At level %1$s each dart rises to %2$s power and the range to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragondarts.preference: On (Split): with two foes each dart chases one at x1 each, covering both. Off (Focus): both darts chase the chosen target at x1.2 each, stacking damage on one foe.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; higher opens from further away.
On: low-health targets rank higher for a two-dart finish. Off: all targets rank the same.
On: prefer to fire when another foe stands near the target, since Split can chase both. Off: rank like any other ranged attack.
When on, the companion may leave its post to fire under a Hold order; off only fires at what it can reach from where it stands.
